How we track results

Final statistics exclude provisional results and pending picks. Win rate is wins ÷ (wins + losses); pushes are excluded. Profit estimates use your standard bet amount from Settings (default $10) per selection, and same-game sportsbook pricing may differ.

Closing-line value compares each pick’s posted price with the best price any sportsbook still offered on the same side of the same line about 20 minutes before kickoff. “Beat the close” means the posted price was better than that closing price. The percentage is how much better or worse the payout was. For parlays, it compares the combined odds and needs a closing price for every leg. Consistently beating the close is one of the clearest signs of an edge, and it shows up much faster than win–loss records do.

Provisional results use reported stats. Final box score not confirmed means the result can still change. Confirmation requires final game stats and an unchanged repeat check at least five minutes later.

One losing leg establishes a parlay loss even if other games have not finished. A parlay win needs every leg graded as a win or push. Missing stats never count as zero, and a missing player row does not establish non-participation or a void.

Only snapshots verified against pregame provider offers appear here. Historical replays, unverified older submissions and personal slips are excluded. The original launch record contains generated selections. Starting with the Sept. 24–28 slate, official picks are selected centrally and kept separate from user-generated combinations. Earlier results remain in the history.

Weekly caps: 100 individual props, 15 Okay, Hear Me Out parlays, 10 What If? parlays and 5 Could You Imagine? parlays. These are ceilings, not quotas. Official picks require fresh, two-sided prices from at least three books and at least a one-percentage-point price edge. Picks publish during the 24 hours before kickoff as the board refreshes; publication closes five minutes before kickoff. Original odds and selections are never replaced by a refresh.

To reduce overlap, official singles use one market per player/game and at most eight picks per game. Official parlays use different games, share at most one player/game with another official parlay, and use any player/game at most three times across the weekly parlay record. Weeks run Tuesday noon UTC to Tuesday noon UTC, keeping Monday-night games together.

Results show the latest 500 verified selections. Odds: The Odds API. Player stats: BALLDONTLIE. Some markets need play-by-play verification; later stat corrections may require review.
